description: This header file defines thread utility functions and macros for thread creation, mutex initialization, locking, unlocking, and thread name retrieval, primarily for use with pthreads in a concurrent programming context.

methods.name: createDetachedThread
methods.description: Creates a detached thread executing the specified task with optional thread name.

methods.name: createThread
methods.description: Creates a joinable thread executing the specified task with optional thread name.

methods.name: getThreadName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a thread given its thread ID.

methods.name: mutexInitWithType
methods.description: Initializes a mutex with a specified type (e.g., recursive, error-check).

methods.name: _mutexLock
methods.description: Internal function to lock a mutex, with error localization.

methods.name: mutexLock
methods.description: Macro to lock a mutex, capturing file and line info.

methods.name: _mutexUnlock
methods.description: Internal function to unlock a mutex, with error localization.

methods.name: mutexUnlock
methods.description: Macro to unlock a mutex, capturing file and line info.
